t: Quiet hours begin at ten each night.
Cooking is allowed only in the common kitchen area.
Please keep the hallways clear of bikes and boxes.
Visitors must sign in at the front desk and leave before midnight.
Laundry machines are in the basement, and you can add money to your card near the stairs.
If anything in your room needs to be repaired, submit a request online and a staff member will contact you within two days.
